Product: Dot & Key Age Defense Night Glow Serum
Video Title: Best ceramide moisturisers | dermatologist | Dr. Aanchal Panth
Comment:
▪️Ceramides are my favourite ingredient in a moisturiser. They are are naturally present in skin and are important in maintaining skin integrity and retaining skin barrier. In dry skin, the amount of ceramides produced by skin reduces. So it is a good practise to replace this ceramide with moisturiser containing  this ingredient.

▪️Who will it suit 
✔️All skin types 
✔️Dry skin 
✔️Sensitive skin 
✔️Oily skin
✔️Combination skin 

▪️When to use 
➡️Use it twice a day over your serums or once at night over your night cream 

👩‍⚕️Recommendations: 
✅Oryza @alembic_pharmaceuticals 
This is very light weight yet moisturising. I prefer this on oily and combination skin type. 
Price: Rs 814 for 50 g

✅Formula RX peptide ceramide @theformularx 
This has added peptides, so if you are above 30 years of age, this is a good choice. Suits all skin types 
Price: Rs 699 for 50 g

✅Dot and key ceramide skin barrier cream @dotandkey.skincare 
I have been loving this one. It is light weight yet moisturising . This is one of the most reasonably priced ceramide creams. Suitable for all skin types. 
Price : Rs. 395 for 100g

✅Suganda squalane ceramide @suganda.co 
This is the thickest of them all also feels the most moisturising. I recommend this for dry or sensitive skin type. Use this at night. 
Price: Rs 1100 for 50 ml

Comment:
Niacinamide is a popular ingredient. I look at this ingredient as a jack of all. It suits all skin types if you use the correct one but is not the panacea for all skin concerns. 

❌Using as solo agent  for acne
✅Need stronger anti acne agents. 
Though niacinamide helps in controlling sebum and has anti inflammatory properties, it will not control active active as a solo agent. It may work for mild occasional acne but for others, you will require stinger agents like benzoyl peroxide or adapalene. 

❌Using only niacinamide for dark spots
✅works well in concoction with other skin lightening agents 
Niacinamide does help in reducing dark spots by causing redistribution of Melanosomes.  It is a mild skin lightening agents. It may work for faint dark spots but for more pronounced dark spots use arbutin or kojic acid. 

❌Applying on dry skin 
✅Niacinamide is best absorbed on damp skin. If it combination with other stringer active agents then you can yours on dry skinZ otherwise as a solo agent, application on damp skin gives best results. 

❌Starting with higher concentration 
✅Start with 5 % 
Though it is a non irritating soothing ingredient, higher concentrations of 10% or more can irritate skin especially if you have sensitive skin. So stick to 5-10% and not more. As a beginner use 5 % . 

❌Not being consistent
✅you have to use it consistently for at least 4 week to see results. 
Results with niaicnamide may be subtle and not visible early on. Buy on regular usage you will notice an improvement in skin tone and texture.

Comment:
At 15 I started dealing with acne.
At the time I wasn't really into skin care and only used a bar soap from "Dove" and body lotion(lol).

Sometimes when I noticed that my face was really oily i skipped the moisturizing step.
However my acne began getting worst and some pimple appeared on highly visible parts of my face like: tip of the nose and forehead.

When that happened I was so ashamed of being looked at,especially from the opposite sex.

I wasn't using make up yet and my self esteem was low and my acne continued to get worst.

________________________________________
So I started researching ✨. 

1)First, search for your skin type.


I discovered that I had acne prone skin/ sensitive skin and combination skin.

Combination skin is when some parts of your face are more oily than others.
The oily spot are usually on the cheeks, and forehead (that is also where the acne usually appears).

How did I know I had combination skin?

Well, after I washed my face I simply didn't moisturize.

If after 10 min or so, certain parts of your face is oily then you have combination skin, if your face is still really dry then you have dry skin, if all parts of your face is oily then you have oily skin. 

Note that there are other skin types and knowing yours is essential.
I will be explaining how to get rid of acne prone skin /sensitive skin and combination skin (since I have that) but if you have another skin type such as dry skin, you can still take SOME of these advices.
Just remember that less products is more.

                _______________________

2)Stop using bar soaps on your face.

If you have combination skin like I do, oily skin or dry skin then I would suggest that.

Body bar soaps dry up the skin and when your skin is really dry without a good moisturizer, it will start producing oil in an attempt to moisturize itself. 
This leads to clogged pores and acne.

                 _____________________

3)Invest in a cleanser.

CeraVe have cleansers for all types of skin.
I use the " CeraVe Bleamish Control Cleanser for Bleamish-prone skin".

Acne prone skin products / sensitive skin usually contain a certain amount of salicylic acid which unclogges pores and reduce swelling and redness.

                 ______________________

4)WASH YOUR HANDS BEFORE TOUCHING YOUR FACE.

This is extremely important.

Its important that the germs in your hands that get accumulated throughout the day dont get into contact with your face.
When you cleans your face wash your hands first. PLEASE.

               _______________________

5)Invest in a good moisturizer

If you have combination skin or oily skin it's important that you look for unparfumed, fragrance free moisturizers.
They can clog the skin especially if you have sensitive skin.
I use " hydrating light moisturizer " from Simple.

              ______________________

6)If you have oily skin or combination skin DO NOT use oily products.

Carefully read the ingredients if your products have any kind of oil listed.
  
                 _____________________

7)Invest in a scrub (not for dry skin).

If you have oily skin or combination skin, it's very important that you invest in a good scrub. 
I use " Clear & Defend facial scrub " from Neutrogena.
This will help you dissolve the oil on your skin and unclog pores.
However if you have dry skin it will further dry it up causing an intese production of sebum (oil) clogging your pores.
However this DOESNT MEAN that dry skin shouldn't use a scrub.
It just means that they don't need to use it as often as the other skin types.

If I'm correct the scrub I use contains salicylic acid and if your skin ain't used to such chemical it is important to use it less at the beginning and gradually increase the amount.

For example if you begin using a scrub containing salicylic acid I would reccomend using it 1/2 times a week for sometime and then increase it to 3/4.

               ____________________
8)Change your pillowcase weekly.

Hair, dust, sweat and dead skin will accumulate in the pillow so it's important to change it weekly.
I'm a Side sleeper and if you also are, it doesn't matter how good of a skin routine you have if you don't change your pillowcase, you will break out.

                    _____________________ 
9)use the right amount of product for your face.

It's important that you use the right amount for you. 
For example: the amount of cream the face needs to be moisturized is a pea size. 
When you want to moisturize your face take out your index, squeeze your moisturizer to create the shape of a pea.

After that, I usually split the "pea" into 4 different dots into my face: 2 for the cheeks , 1 for the forehead and the last one for the chin. 

               ___________________

10)Emotionally prepare for your skin purging.

Skin purging is a temporary skin reaction to specific ingredients that cause breakouts, dryness, flaking, and peeling.

There are some products  that aim to help people have clear skin by containing active ingredients such as salicylic and hyaluronic acid, that speed up the exfoliation process to renew the skin.

When I first started using salicylic acid products my skin purged for 9 days (or maybe 2 weeks, but not more than that).

I had lots of white heads and bumbs.

Thankfully I had decided of trying the products on a Christmas vacation so that I had no one who could see me purging.

After my skin slowly became accustomed to the salicylic acid,I began not to break out anymore (unless I'm on my period).

Purging is GOOD but if it lasts more than a month I suggest switching products.


                 _______________________

Bonus advice) Be patient .

I actually have many more advice to give but the comment is already too long so I will end it here.
I hope you find any of these advices useful!.
